pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to positions inside high-frequency consolidation bands; pyramid only after a confirmed 15-minute structural breakout with expanding volume.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require order book imbalance > 65% and ATR(14) expansion above baseline prior to market execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% at +$10, trail remaining position with an adaptive volatility stop to capture +$15 to +$30 runs.
